points.title: 早期音乐教育
points.description: 亨德尔在哈雷大学学习，接受了良好的音乐教育，包括作曲和演奏。这段时间对他日后的音乐生涯产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Handel studied at the University of Halle, receiving a solid musical education, including composition and performance. This period had a profound impact on his future musical career.

points.title: 汉堡歌剧生涯
points.description: 在汉堡，亨德尔开始了他的歌剧生涯，创作了多部歌剧，包括《阿尔米德》。他在这里建立了自己的声誉，并开始受到公众的认可。
points.descriptionEn: In Hamburg, Handel began his opera career, writing several operas, including 'Almira'. He established his reputation here and began to gain public recognition.

points.title: 汉诺威宫廷乐师
points.description: 亨德尔成为汉诺威选帝侯的宫廷乐师，负责宫廷音乐。在这里，他创作了《里纳尔多》，这是他的第一部意大利歌剧。
points.descriptionEn: Handel became the court composer for the Elector of Hanover, responsible for court music. Here, he composed 'Rinaldo', his first Italian opera.

points.title: 伦敦音乐生涯
points.description: 亨德尔移居伦敦，并迅速成为英国音乐界的领军人物。他创作了《弥赛亚》和《水上音乐》，这些作品使他成为国际知名的音乐家。
points.descriptionEn: Handel moved to London and quickly became a leading figure in the British musical world. He composed 'Messiah' and 'Water Music', which made him an internationally renowned musician.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 在伦敦的晚年，亨德尔继续创作了许多重要的作品，包括《以色列人在埃及》和《所罗门》。他的音乐风格和创作技巧对后世产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years in London, Handel continued to compose many important works, including 'Israel in Egypt' and 'Solomon'. His musical style and compositional techniques had a profound impact on future generations.

supporter.zh: 亨德尔被视为巴洛克音乐的代表人物之一，他的作品对后世音乐产生了深远的影响。他的音乐才华和创造力被认为是无与伦比的，他的作品如《弥赛亚》和《水上音乐》至今仍广受欢迎。
supporter.en: Handel is regarded as one of the greatest representatives of Baroque music, and his works have had a profound impact on music history. His musical talent and creativity are considered unparalleled, and his compositions like 'Messiah' and 'Water Music' are still widely beloved today.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为亨德尔的音乐过于复杂和装饰性，缺乏创新。他的音乐风格有时被认为过于传统，无法与同时代的其他音乐家相比。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Handel's music is too complex and ornate, lacking innovation. His musical style is sometimes seen as too traditional, unable to compare with other contemporary composers.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，亨德尔被广泛认为是巴洛克音乐的巨匠，他的作品在音乐史上占有重要地位。在大众文化中，他通常被符号化为巴洛克音乐的代表人物。
objective.en: In the academic community, Handel is widely regarded as a master of Baroque music, with his works holding a significant place in musical history. In popular culture, he is often symbolized as a representative of Baroque music.

self.en: Music is the language of my soul.

others.zh: 亨德尔是音乐史上最伟大的作曲家之一。
others.en: Handel is one of the greatest composers in the history of music.
